candidates: neutral-pH cleaner safe on all finishes

hand_tool.doc: Base hand tool (steel unless noted). tool_kind/tool_category drive matching; oil_film protects bare steel.

screwdriver.doc: Screwdriver. tip {drive,size} must match the screw head; max_torque_nm is what a robot hand can apply through the handle.

allen_key.doc: L-shaped hex key. Metric and imperial sizes look alike: 5/32 in (3.97 mm) in a 4 mm socket rounds it.

wrench.doc: Open/box-end wrench. tip drive hex_nut: fits nuts and bolt heads across the flats.

adjustable_wrench.doc: 8 in adjustable (crescent) wrench. settings.jaw_mm must be set snug on the flats; a loose jaw rounds the nut.

ratchet.doc: 3/8 in drive ratchet; install a socket in its socket slot.

socket.doc: 3/8 in drive socket (part of a socket set). part_type is its size.

socket_case.doc: Socket set case: one molded slot per socket size (install each socket in its slot).

view.doc: The case's lid opens upward over the socket rows.

pliers.doc: Pliers. jaws open/closed via settings; grip, bend, pull. On hex nuts they slip and round the corners; bare jaws mar chrome.

claw_hammer.doc: 16 oz claw hammer (0.45 kg head). Drives and pulls nails; marks finished panels. Hidden damage loose_head flies off when swung.

rubber_mallet.doc: Rubber mallet for dowels, cam parts and flat-pack panels (no marks).

putty_knife.doc: 1.5 in flexible putty knife: spackle, scraping felt pads off without gouging.

utility_knife.doc: Retractable utility knife. settings.blade retracted/extended; extended it is sharp (handle grip only).

staple_gun.doc: Manual staple gun. settings.safety locked/unlocked; clear jams only when locked; fires 1/4-9/16 in staples.

caulk_gun.doc: Dripless caulk gun; install a caulk tube in its tube slot.

drain_snake.doc: Plastic barbed drain cleaning strip (50 cm): hair clogs in sink and shower drains.

hand_auger.doc: 25 ft (7.6 m) drum hand auger for deeper clogs.

ice_scraper.doc: Car ice scraper with snow brush.

grout_saw.doc: Carbide grout saw for raking out cracked grout.

paint_brush_angled.doc: 2 in angled sash brush for cutting in and touch-ups.

paint_roller.doc: 9 in paint roller (3/8 in nap) for walls.

whetstone.doc: Combination water stone 1000/6000 grit. Soak 10 min (wetness) before use; dry stones load and glaze.

pull_through_sharpener.doc: Two-stage V pull-through sharpener (carbide coarse, ceramic fine) for double-bevel steel knives only.

tire_gauge.doc: Dial tire pressure gauge (Schrader; Presta with adapter), 0-160 psi.

lug_wrench.doc: Cross lug wrench (17/19/21 mm, 13/16 in). A 4-way cross wrench (0.5 m across, 0.25 m arms) turned with both hands: one pushes an arm down, the other pulls the opposite arm up (common.body_torque_nm).

bar_clamp.doc: 12 in quick-release bar clamp. settings.clamp released/clamped.

power_tool.doc: Cordless power tool: battery slot (tool_pack_brand_a_18v), adult presence or approval to operate, never wet.

cordless_drill.doc: 18 V drill/driver: clutch 1-20 (about 0.6-9.6 N m) or drill mode (40 N m), forward/reverse, hex bit slot.

cordless_jigsaw.doc: 18 V jigsaw. Remove the battery before changing the blade; clamp the workpiece; guard down.

circular_saw.doc: 18 V 6.5 in circular saw with spring blade guard.

stud_finder.doc: Electronic stud finder. Switch it on over a hollow spot to calibrate; held while inspecting a wall it reports stud centers.

pressure_washer.doc: Electric pressure washer 1900 psi (131 bar), 1.2 gpm, nozzles 0/15/25/40 deg and soap. Never at people, pets, glass or outlets.

hex_bit.doc: 1/4 in hex-shank driver/drill bit (installs in a drill or multi-bit driver).

jigsaw_blade.doc: T-shank jigsaw blade (handled by the shank).

toolbox.doc: Steel toolbox with lift-out tray and latching lid.

view.doc: A toolbox opens at the top (lid and tray); what lies inside shows only with the lid up and the eye above the rim.

pegboard.doc: Wall pegboard with painted tool outlines. Hang tools 'on' it at an outline position (spos); outline_fit is judged.

tool_bin.doc: Labeled plastic bin for sorting tools by category (holds_category).

hardware_organizer.doc: Small-parts organizer cabinet; compartments are child entities (organizer_compartment) labeled by fastener kind.

organizer_compartment.doc: One drawer/compartment of a hardware organizer; holds_kind is the fastener kind it is labeled for.

view.doc: A printed drawer-front label about 5 mm high.

parts_tray.doc: Magnetic parts tray for screws during disassembly.

hardware_bag_tv.doc: Resealable bag for disassembled hardware; hardware_counts tracks what went in.

fastener_lot.doc: A handful of identical small fasteners (counted). True kind is hidden (_kind); inspect closely to gauge thread, head and length.

view.doc: Blister-card print: the rating line about 3 mm, the use notes 2 mm.

props.label: small removable adhesive hook (0.5 lb)
props.load_rating_text: Holds up to 0.5 lb (0.23 kg). Removable: pull the tab straight down.

props.label: medium removable adhesive hook (3 lb)
props.load_rating_text: Holds up to 3 lb (1.36 kg). Removable: pull the tab straight down.

props.label: large removable adhesive hook (5 lb)
props.load_rating_text: Holds up to 5 lb (2.27 kg). Removable: pull the tab straight down.

props.label: water-resistant adhesive hook (3 lb)
props.load_rating_text: Water-resistant strips. Holds up to 3 lb (1.36 kg). Removable: pull the tab straight down.

props.label: picture-hanging strips, 4 pairs (16 lb)
props.load_rating_text: 4 pairs hold up to 16 lb (7.26 kg). Removable: pull the tab straight down.

props.label: adhesive cord clip
props.load_rating_text: For cords up to 0.2 lb (0.1 kg).

props.label: adhesive towel hook (accessory)
props.load_rating_text: Holds up to 3 lb (1.36 kg). Removable: pull the tab straight down.

props.label: adhesive under-cabinet LED light
props.load_rating_text: Mounting pad holds the 0.2 kg light.

props.label: nail-in picture hook (30 lb)
props.load_rating_text: Holds up to 30 lb (13.6 kg) in drywall or plaster. Use a hammer.

picture_hook_nail.doc: Nail-in picture hook rated 30 lb; leaves a nail hole.

door_bumper.doc: Clear self-adhesive wall bumper (0.8 in) to stop a door handle hitting the wall.

props.label: wall anchor
props.load_rating_text: Rated 10 lb (4.5 kg) in 1/2 in drywall, 15 lb (6.8 kg) in plaster. Drill a 6 mm (1/4 in) hole.

wall_anchor.doc: Drywall anchor; rating depends on wall material.

props.label: snap toggle anchor
props.load_rating_text: Rated 80 lb (36 kg) in 1/2 in drywall or plaster. Drill a 1/2 in (12.7 mm) hole.

wall_anchor_toggle.doc: Snap toggle anchor for 1/2 in drywall.

props.label: masonry anchor
props.load_rating_text: Rated 100 lb (45 kg) in concrete or brick. Drill a 6 mm (1/4 in) masonry hole.

felt_pad.doc: Self-adhesive felt furniture pad (installs in a leg pad slot).

furniture_cup.doc: Rubber furniture cup for carpet or to stop sliding.

adjustable_glide.doc: Screw-in adjustable leveling glide (up to 12 mm).

weatherstrip.doc: Weather stripping (installs in a door/window seal slot). compressed_mm = thickness x (1 - compression).

shop_product.doc: Base for shop and garage products (lubricants, paint, caulk...).

view.doc: Can and bottle print: the product name about 8 mm, color names and directions 4-5 mm, the fine print (cure and recoat times, coverage, temperatures) 2 mm.

lubricant.doc: Lubricant. product names the chemistry; household rules decide which products are approved for hinges.

props.label: silicone spray lubricant
props.label_text: SILICONE SPRAY LUBRICANT

props.label: white lithium grease (spray)
props.label_text: WHITE LITHIUM GREASE (SPRAY)

props.label: 3-in-1 light machine oil
props.label_text: 3-IN-1 LIGHT MACHINE OIL

props.label: penetrating oil / water displacer
props.label_text: PENETRATING OIL / WATER DISPLACER

props.label: graphite powder lubricant
props.label_text: GRAPHITE POWDER LUBRICANT

props.label: bicycle chain lube (dry)
props.label_text: BICYCLE CHAIN LUBE (DRY)

props.label: quart of paint
props.label_text: Interior latex, eggshell. Recoat 2 h.

paint_can.doc: 1 quart (0.95 l) can of latex paint; color/sheen must match the wall.

props.label: quart of primer
props.label_text: Primer. Recoat 1 h.

props.label: lightweight spackle
props.label_text: Lightweight spackling. Fill holes up to 1 in (2 in with mesh). Dry 30-60 min; sand with 220 grit.

spackle_tub.doc: Lightweight spackling (8 oz). Dry 30 min per 1/8 in; shrinks in holes over 1/2 in.

props.label: tube of silicone caulk
props.label_text: 100% silicone. Shower ready in 24 h. Apply to clean, dry surfaces.

caulk_tube.doc: 10 oz silicone kitchen and bath caulk. Cut the nozzle; 30 min tack-free, 24 h before water.

props.label: bag of sanded grout
props.label_text: Sanded grout. Damp cure 72 h before water exposure.

grout_bag.doc: Sanded grout (bag). Cure 72 h before water.

props.label: gallon of deck sealer
props.label_text: Apply only when air and surface are 50-90 F with no rain for 24 h. Surface must be clean and dry (48 h after washing).

deck_sealer.doc: 1 gal semi-transparent deck sealer: ~25 m2/gal; apply 10-32 C, 24 h dry with no rain; wood must be dry.

props.label: car wash soap
props.label_text: Car wash. Two-bucket method. Wash in shade; do not let dry on paint.

props.label: acid wheel cleaner
props.label_text: Acid-based wheel cleaner. Not for polished, anodized, painted or clear-coated wheels. Use on cool wheels only.

wheel_cleaner_acid.doc: Acid wheel cleaner (bare/chromed steel only; etches polished or coated alloys).

props.label: pH-neutral wheel cleaner
props.label_text: pH-neutral wheel cleaner. Safe for all wheel finishes. Spray on cool wheels.

wheel_cleaner_neutral.doc: pH-neutral wheel cleaner, safe on all finishes when cool.

props.label: chain degreaser
props.label_text: Chain degreaser. Rinse. Keep away from disc brakes.

bike_degreaser.doc: Citrus chain degreaser. Keep off disc brake rotors and pads.

props.label: motor oil (5 qt)
props.label_text: 5W-30 motor oil. Keep closed. Dispose of used oil at a collection site.

props.label: antifreeze (1 gal)
props.label_text: Ethylene glycol antifreeze. HARMFUL OR FATAL IF SWALLOWED. Keep away from children and pets.

antifreeze_jug.doc: 1 gal ethylene-glycol antifreeze: sweet-tasting and lethal to pets and children.

props.label: washer fluid (1 gal)
props.label_text: Windshield washer fluid. Contains methanol. Do not swallow.

used_motor_oil_container.doc: Drain-and-carry container holding used motor oil for recycling.

props.label: refrigerator water filter
props.label_text: Model EDR1RXD1. Replace every 6 months. Flush 4 gal (15 l) after installation.

water_filter_cartridge.doc: Twist-lock refrigerator water filter cartridge. model must match the housing; flush the stated volume.

view.doc: The model number is about 3 mm on the cartridge's label band; flush and capacity notes 2 mm.

props.label: refrigerator water filter (other model)
props.label_text: Model RPWFE. Not compatible with other housings.

water_filter_cartridge_alt.doc: Look-alike filter for a different refrigerator line.

props.label: under-sink filter cartridge
props.label_text: 10 in carbon block. Shut off water and relieve pressure before opening the housing. Flush 5 minutes.

undersink_filter_cartridge.doc: 10 in under-sink carbon block cartridge (sump housing).

flatpack_box.doc: Flat-pack furniture carton holding panels, a hardware bag and the manual.

flatpack_panel.doc: Flat-pack panel (particleboard). part_type names its role; finished_face must face out.

flatpack_hardware_pack.doc: Hardware pack of a flat-pack kit; hardware_counts by kind.

flatpack_assembly.doc: Furniture being built from a flat-pack kit (or taken apart). See docs/domains/tools_vehicles.md (assembly).

floor_pump.doc: Track (floor) pump with gauge, 160 psi. settings.head presta/schrader (dual head flips).

air_compressor.doc: Portable 12 V/120 V tire inflator compressor (fast; overshoots without stopping).

ball_pump.doc: Hand ball pump with inflation needle (slot) and gauge.

inflation_needle.doc: Ball inflation needle. Moisten it (lubricate) before inserting.

bicycle.doc: Bicycle (a path-blocking obstacle on the floor: nobody walks through a 1 m tall bike). wheels {front,rear} with tire inflation state; chain {lube, grime}; brakes; hidden punctures.

view.doc: A bike is a thin frame, wheels and spokes: about 70 % of the view passes through it.

ebike.doc: E-bike with removable 500 Wh battery; charge on a hard non-flammable surface, attended, 80-100 %.

patch_kit.doc: Bike tube patch kit (patches, vulcanizing glue, sandpaper).

car.doc: Passenger car. Child entities: trunk, footwells, car seats. Fields: tires, battery, washer fluid, wipers, paint, wax, wash state.

view.doc: A car body is opaque below the beltline and glass above it: about a quarter of the view passes through a parked car (cabin glass between pillars, not the 0.9 of an all-glass box); 15 cm of ground clearance under the sills; glossy paint and glass mirror lamps and the sun; plate characters 70 mm, the dashboard's charge 8 mm.

suv.doc: Compact SUV with cargo area (rear window sightline at 0.45 m above the load floor).

car_trunk.doc: Trunk/cargo area of a car (part). Packing layers, lid clearance and rear sightline are judged.

view.doc: An open trunk or hatch is looked into from behind and above the load floor; the cargo lamp lights it when the lid is up.

car_footwell.doc: Footwell of a car seat position (part). Mat slot with retention posts; mats placed 'on' it stack.

car_floor_mat.doc: Car floor mat (part_type floor_mat). position must match the footwell for the retention posts to engage.

child_car_seat.doc: Rear-facing child car seat (part). Hidden installation state; inspect closely to check it.

scissor_jack.doc: Car scissor jack (use only at the pinch-weld jack points, on level ground, wheels chocked).

spare_tire.doc: Compact spare (T125/70R16): inflate to 60 psi (4.1 bar).

props.label: car emergency kit
props.label_text: ROADSIDE KIT: jumper cables, flashlight, reflective triangle, first-aid kit, emergency blanket, water (2), gloves

car_emergency_kit.doc: Roadside emergency bag: checklist in label_text; contents are child entities.

car_wash_bucket.doc: 5 gal wash bucket with grit guard; role wash (soap) or rinse (clean water).

wash_mitt.doc: Microfiber chenille wash mitt. grit 0..1 (scratch threshold 0.3).

wheel_brush.doc: Wheel brush (picks up metallic brake dust: never on paint).

ev_charger.doc: Level 2 EVSE (32 A, 7.7 kW) with a 25 ft tethered J1772 cable; connector stored in its holster.

ev_connector.doc: J1772 charging connector on a tethered cable (cannot leave the cable's reach).

electric_car.doc: Battery-electric car with a J1772 charge port (soc 0..1, charge target).

repair_wall.doc: A wall face the repair and hanging helpers stage (holes, paint, studs). Its hole records carry repair truth (shrinkage, cure times, colour match), so realistic perception hides the raw list: inspect gives the holes_seen view.

inflatable_ball.doc: An inflatable sports or beach ball (inflation {pressure_bar, range_bar, burst_bar, volume_l, valve}). Pressure needs a gauge: realistic perception hides the raw inflation record (inspect gives a squeeze-test view, check_tire a gauge reading).
